title: Core Types & EventStream (Foundation)
description:
Implement the foundational types and EventStream from docs/plans/01-ai-core.md.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Sections: §3 (Core Types), §4 (Event Types & EventStream), time.go helpers

Key deliverables:
- Message interface (sealed) with UserMessage, AssistantMessage, ToolResultMessage
- ContentBlock interface (sealed) with TextContent, ThinkingContent, ImageContent, ToolCall
- Usage, UsageCost structs
- StopReason constants (stop, length, toolUse, error, aborted)
- Tool struct (Name, Description, Parameters as json.RawMessage)
- Context struct (SystemPrompt, Messages, Tools)
- StreamOptions, SimpleStreamOptions, ThinkingLevel, CacheRetention, ThinkingBudgets
- EventType enum (start, text_start/delta/end, thinking_start/delta/end, toolcall_start/delta/end, done, error)
- AssistantMessageEvent tagged union
- EventStream struct with terminal-state guarantee (atomic.Bool + CompareAndSwap)
- NewEventStream, Send, Close (idempotent via sync.Once), Result, Drain
- ErrStreamClosedWithoutTerminalEvent sentinel error
- TimeToMillis, MillisToTime helper functions
- Unit tests for all types and EventStream (send/receive, Result(), Drain(), Close idempotency, concurrent access)
- Test harness tests: P1 (EventStream ordering with rapid), P5 (terminal-state guarantee), D1 (simulated slow consumer), D2 (context cancellation timing), S1 (1M event throughput), B1 (EventStream benchmark)
- All tests must pass with -race flag

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/01-ai-core.md §3, §4
- Test harness: docs/plans/01-ai-core-test-harness.md §1 (P1, P5), §4 (S1), §5 (B1), §6 (D1, D2)
- Depends on: nothing (this is the foundation)
